name: Borealin (Cell division cycle-associated protein 8) (Dasra-B) (hDasra-B) (Pluripotent embryonic stem cell-related gene 3 protein)
features: Required to form a minimal CPC core complex that localizes to the central spindle and midbody and properly executes the role of the CPC during cytokinesis
Required for interaction with INCENP and BIRC5
Glycyl lysine isopeptide (Lys-Gly) (interchain with G-Cter in SUMO2)
